form.exchangeRateHintAriaLabel: What the exchange rate is for in PandaTrack
form.exchangeRateHint: PandaTrack uses this number to convert this order into your base currency. That way what you see when you open the app and your budget stay in the same currency. Enter how many {to} equal 1 {from}, using the real rate you paid (bank or card).
form.baseCurrencyBannerText: We'll show you how much you've spent in total, even when you buy from stores in different countries. Just choose your base currency and we'll convert each order to it for you.

form.itemsShortcutsAddBelow: Insert a new row below (inherits product type)
form.itemsShortcutsTabHint: Tab / Shift + Tab also move between cells. Tab on the last cell adds a new row.
